headline: Carnival (CCL) Stock Still Looks Undervalued Following Its 139% Rebound
summary: Carnival has seen a sharp rebound over the past few years and fresh headlines around demand for cruises, which naturally puts a spotlight on whether the current share price lines up with what the business is earning. With that backdrop, the question for you today is how much of this recovery story is already accounted for in the earnings that underpin the valuation.
